text: {"name":"wlc_event_dispatch","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Processes a WLAN/controller event by retiring older queued records, updating context flags, and dispatching station or scan/link-layer work as needed.","subsystem":"wlan","var_renames":{"v4":"queue_entry","v8":"entry_order_value","v9":"global_event_counter","v11":"queue_entry_missing","v14":"activity_index","v19":"context_event_counter"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":80,"meaning":"Timestamp-like value compared with the supplied event time using a ±50 window."},{"offset":85,"meaning":"Context status flags modified and tested by this function."},{"offset":86,"meaning":"Optional station/peer index; 0xff selects a separate handling path."},{"offset":1224,"meaning":"Gate indicating whether activity-index handling is enabled."},{"offset":1225,"meaning":"Activity index used to select a 140-byte activity record."}]}
